boltons scalar clamp validates upper < lower then uses min(max(x, lower), upper), so a generator can validate before acquiring its first source item and delegate each item without coercion.
more_itertools already imports math.comb and has an explicit __all__; lexicographic skipped-prefix counts have a binomial-difference formula, avoiding n-sized pools or enumeration.

dotenv Binding exposes error and original.line directly; dictionary assignment preserves first insertion position while replacing repeated values, and retaining value directly preserves None versus empty string.

findings.evidence: These boundaries follow TASK s1; parse_binding marks original before consuming multiline whitespace, so strict line reporting must use binding.original.line rather than recomputing the visible key line.
